notes: RUN 20 CYCLE 7, FOUND AND REMEDIATED WITHIN THE SAME CYCLE. Cycle 6 separated signals correctly and then absorbed each non-selected signal into the FIRST selected body it depended on, in module-id order. That is arbitrary, and B2.1 is where it did harm: the cost forecast arm rests overwhelmingly on the earned-value measurement and touches the document evidence only through its sampling spread, yet with the index arm absent it was absorbed by name order into the DOCUMENT body, whose band then became its adverse earned-value reading. A document body read Red on no document evidence, and combining that against the earned-value body drove Red belief from 0.3974 to 0.9526. THAT IS FALSE REINFORCEMENT ARRIVING THROUGH THE ABSORPTION STEP RATHER THAN THE SEPARATION STEP, and the first-in-order rule could not have been right except by luck. A bridge is now absorbed into the body it shares the MOST PRIMITIVE EVIDENCE with, a set comparison over the identifiers the separation already uses and not a weight, a threshold or a correlation estimate; ties fall back to the declared body order. Every cycle 6 figure was remeasured afterwards and NONE moved: suppression 0.7000, 0.8000 and 0.8340, the independent pair 0.9273 with conflict 0.4414, both acceptance counters zero, and the non-transitive oracle in all six orderings. CLOSED BY THIS CYCLE.
